jorge: Ran the 120-day recurrence scan. Top recurring signature: "kv-cache stale on node churn" — 12 hits.
lena: ouch. that's the one that caused the 15% P95 tail spikes last month.
vikram: i'll own a consolidated postmortem doc and correlation table. ticket: RPT-1101.
maya: i'll take infra remediation (RPT-1102) - plan: early-warm hook + safer invalidation.
jorge: ops-bot created digest: recurrence-sweep-2265 -> https://redwood.internal/ops/digests/2265
vikram: quick hypothesis list: 1) race between cache invalidation and fetch path, 2) autoscaler thinning warm pool, 3) boot-order change in AMI.
lena: monitoring gaps: no dedicated kv_cache_stale_rate tile. i'll add dashboard, alert P0 if >4% sustained 10m. ticket MON-334.
maya: infra plan: add warm hook, add prefetch in init, then AMI bake test in staging. target prototype 2026-04-02.
vikram: postmortem timeline: draft by 2026-04-01, include timelines, repro steps, minimal harness. will attach SQL used.
lena: sample query to group signatures:
```
SELECT signature, count(*) AS hits, min(created_at) as first_seen, max(created_at) as last_seen
FROM incident_signatures
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '120 days'
GROUP BY signature
ORDER BY hits DESC;
```
jorge: owners & deadlines quick:
- RPT-1101: Vikram - postmortem & repro - due 2026-04-01
- RPT-1102: Maya - infra prototype + AMI test - due 2026-04-02
- MON-334: Lena - dashboard + alerts - due 2026-03-30
- COMMS-71: Jorge - internal FAQ & support note - due 2026-04-04
lena: i'll also wire a synthetic that simulates pod churn and measure kv_cache_miss and tail latency.
maya: canary rule: rollback if tail latency > 1.5x baseline for 5m. i'll implement gate in the deploy script.
vikram: please tag all PRs/tickets `pattern=kv-cache-churn` and include correlation id `kvchurn-2265` so recurrence scans link them.
ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync 2026-04-05 09:00 PT.
jorge: thanks. keep updates in ticket threads; reopen here only for synthesis or blockers. :thumbsup:
